'''Silman''' was an elderly [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a former aide of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Silman accompanied [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] during a mission to resolve a dispute on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. However, their shuttle was shot down by the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] under the orders of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Silman survived and was imprisoned by the Pykes for several years. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], he was rescued by Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. He was murdered by Dooku before he could reveal the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice's]] role in Sifo-Dyas's [[Death/Legends|death]].

==Biography==
Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Silman accompanied [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] when he was sent to try and resolve a dispute with the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]]. This was a secret negotiation and therefore was not reported to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. En route to Oba Diah, they were diverted to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] to resolve a tribal dispute. They never reached Felucia, as the Pykes shot down their shuttle. Sifo-Dyas was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the crash, but Silman survived. The Pyke Syndicate handed Sifo-Dyas' body off to Dooku, but the Pykes secretly held onto Silman, planning to use him as a bargaining chip, in case the Pykes needed to resolve their part on [[Dooku/Legends|Tyranus's]] attack on Sifo-Dyas with the Jedi.<ref name="The Lost One" />

[[File:TLO-Silman_file.png|thumb|left|A younger Silman, as seen in his file]]
Late in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] traveled to [[Oba Diah/Legends|Oba Diah]] to find Silman after discovering he was with Sifo-Dyas. [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]] was hesitant, but led them to the captive Silman's cell, in exchange for amnesty over the Pykes' betrayal of the Jedi. Silman's time spent isolated in his cell and his belief that he had been left for dead caused his mental state to degrade severely. He treated the insects in his cell as pets, having had only them for company, and spoke in rambling sentences. When Obi-Wan wanted information, specifically about Sifo-Dyas, Silman's memory appeared to work, as he remembered that there was someone else who wanted to "be Sifo-Dyas," and ordered the Pykes to attack them, but before he could say who, Dooku killed Silman by [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|choking him]]. However Dooku had betrayed his identity, so Anakin and Obi-Wan knew that Dooku had a hand in Sifo-Dyas's fate and that he was the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Tyranus.<ref name="The Lost One" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:CrazySilman-TLO.png|thumb|right|250px|After more than a decade in isolation, Silman had drifted into insanity.]]
Silman was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with blue eyes, fair skin, and brown hair. He was a senior government official who served as an aide to Chancellor Valorum. Due to his imprisonment by the Pykes, Silman's physical and mental health deteriorated, with his hair turning white and his body being emaciated by starvation.<ref name="SW-The Lost One Episode Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-lost-one-episode-gallery|text="The Lost One" Episode Gallery}}</ref> Silman's loneliness led him to befriend the vermin and lice that inhabited his cell. Despite his condition, Silman still maintained enough cognizance to communicate with Kenobi and Skywalker.<ref name="The Lost One" />

==Equipment==
During his time as a Chancellor's aide, Silman wore white robes and a medallion. By 20 BBY, he had lost his medallion to the Pykes and he wore rags.<ref name="The Lost One" />

==Behind the scenes==
Silman first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions]]'' episode "[[The Lost One]]," which premiered on the streaming platform [[Netflix]] on [[March 7]], [[2014]]. He was voiced by [[Brian George]], who had also voiced [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]].
